Card Q&A.q: While I have a Tamer with [Tai Kamiya] in its name and my opponent has a Digimon with 10000 DP or more, can I use an effect that digivolves my Digimon to digivolve my [Agumon] in the battle area into this card in my hand?

Effect: While you have a Tamer with [Tai Kamiya] in its name and your opponent has a 10000 DP or higher Digimon, any of your [Agumon] can digivolve into this card in your hand for a digivolution cost of 4, ignoring digivolution requirements.
[When Digivolving] This Digimon gains ＜Raid＞ for the turn. Then, it may attack.
[When Attacking] If you have a Tamer, this Digimon gains ＜Security A. +1＞ and ＜Piercing＞ for the turn.
